items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
items.claim: The passage presents what follows as speech from the LORD to Moses.

items.quote: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
items.claim: The LORD says he has called Bezaleel by name. Bezaleel is named as the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
items.object: Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah

items.quote: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
items.claim: Bezaleel's wisdom, understanding, knowledge and skill in all kinds of workmanship are said to come from being filled with the spirit of God.
items.action: filled with the spirit of God

items.quote: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
items.claim: The purpose of this gift is for Bezaleel to design skilled works and to work in gold, silver and brass.
items.action: devise cunning works; work in metals

items.quote: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
items.claim: Bezaleel's gift also covers cutting and setting stones, carving timber, and all kinds of workmanship.
items.action: cut and set stones; carve timber
